from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class CompanyDebtComponent(BaseModel):
    """A component of debt from one company's filing."""
    label: str | None = Field(description="Label as written on the balance sheet (e.g., 'Long-term debt', 'Current maturities')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The amount in the units specified by currency_units")
    currency_units: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the amount: 'thousands', 'millions', etc.")
    is_current_portion: bool = Field(description="Whether this is a current/short-term portion of debt")

class CompanyEquity(BaseModel):
    """Equity information from one company's filing."""
    label: str | None = Field(description="Label as written on the balance sheet (e.g., 'Total Stockholders' Equity')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The amount in the units specified by currency_units")
    currency_units: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the amount: 'thousands', 'millions', etc.")
    is_deficit: bool = Field(description="Whether this equity is negative/deficit")

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data from one company's 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the filing")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The quarter ended date (YYYY-MM format)")
    debt_components: List[CompanyDebtComponent] = Field(description="All debt line items with amounts and labels")
    equity: CompanyEquity | None = Field(description="Total shareholders' equity information")
    quote_debt: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt showing debt figures")
    quote_equity: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt showing equity figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: List[CompanyFinancialData]
